source_instruction: find me a jar of baby food that is certified organic. it should also be non gmo.
query: I swear the community garden down the block has been going absolutely wild this week—yesterday I walked past and the sunflower stalks are taller than my 6’2 neighbor who comes out to water his tomato plants every single evening without fail, and the zinnia beds are bursting with so many bright orange and magenta blooms that even the local bumblebees seem to be zooming around extra giddy like they can’t pick which flower to land on first. I stopped to chat with the retired elementary school teacher who tends the herb section for ten minutes, and she pressed a bundle of fresh lemon basil into my hands that smells so bright and zingy I already know I’m gonna toss it into pasta and iced tea all weekend. I even spotted a tiny baby cottontail rabbit tucked under the cucumber trellis munching on a stray clover leaf, and it was so still and fluffy I almost thought it was a stuffed animal someone left out until it twitched its little nose and hopped off into the marigolds. Hey, can you help me find meat substitutes for me? I’m looking for options that are USDA biodynamic certified, non-GMO, and also come with a free reusable silicone storage pouch included. I don’t want to spend too much, so just stick to stuff that fits what I’m comfortable paying for, yeah? I’d really appreciate it if you could pull up the options that check those boxes for me.

extras.text: come with a free reusable silicone storage pouch included
